description: Product categories (menus.type=categories), live search, discount hours, product list, product detail, and direct checkout (buy now) APIs.
basePathNote: These endpoints work under the /v1 prefix inside the route group. Product detail is a public endpoint. Buy now works for both guest users and authenticated customers. Locale is selected through the Content-Language header.

Content-Language.description: Locale header. Example: az | en | ru. Middleware sets the application locale based on this header.

Authorization.description: Bearer token for authenticated customers. It may be used during buy now requests.

X-Guest-Token.description: Guest cart token. The buy now endpoint uses a temporary cart, but this header may be sent for compatibility with other unauthenticated customer flows.

endpoints.description: Fast live search endpoint for the site header or search input. The q value is searched in three places: active categories where menus.type=categories, active product filter values whose parent filter name or slug matches brand-related keywords, and all active published product variations. Product variation search checks name, slug, description, meta_title, meta_description, meta_keywords, sku, and model. The response is returned in a frontend-ready name + items structure where name can be rendered as a section heading.

q.description: Live search text. Minimum 2 characters and maximum 100 characters. Search is performed in brands, categories, and products sections.

limit.description: Maximum number of results per section. Default is 8 and maximum is 20.

q: Search query must be at least 2 characters.
limit: Limit may not be greater than 20.

endpoints.description: Creates a product purchase request from the product detail popup form. This endpoint does not create an order. It stores the customer's request so that admins can review and contact the customer later. The frontend must send fullname, phone, product_variation_id, and quantity. Product name is not accepted from the frontend because product and variation data are resolved securely from product_variation_id. Authenticated customers may send Authorization: Bearer token; guest users may send X-Guest-Token or cart_token cookie. If no guest token is provided, the backend generates one automatically.
endpoints.authorization: Public. Authorization: Bearer {token} may be sent for authenticated customers.

fullname.description: Customer full name. Minimum 2 characters and maximum 255 characters.

phone.description: Customer phone number. Accepted formats are normalized by the backend to +994XXXXXXXXX.

product_variation_id.description: Product variation ID from product detail active_variation.id or variations[].id.

quantity.description: Requested product quantity. Minimum value is 1 and maximum value is 999.

201.message: Purchase request has been submitted successfully.

phone: Phone number must be a valid Azerbaijan phone number.
product_variation_id: Selected product variation was not found.

endpoints.summary: Product list with optional category, filters, search, and sorting
endpoints.description: Returns a product list. If main_category_id is provided, products from that category and all descendant categories are included, and sidebar filters are built from that category tree. If main_category_id is not provided, the endpoint works as a global list for search, home, brand, or similar pages. When a sidebar filter is selected, both products and available filters with counts are recalculated according to the selected filters. The list is built on product variations with a 1 product = 1 default variation approach.

main_category_id.description: Main category identifier. It accepts menus.id or uuid for records where type=categories. When provided, all descendant categories are included. If omitted, the endpoint works globally.

q.description: Search text. It searches product_variation_translations.name and product_variation_translations.slug with LIKE %q%.

is_new.description: When true, only products marked as new are returned. When false, only products not marked as new are returned. If omitted, this filter is not applied.

is_popular.description: When true, only popular products are returned. When false, only non-popular products are returned. If omitted, this filter is not applied.

most_sale.description: When true, only best-selling products are returned. When false, only products not marked as best-selling are returned. If omitted, this filter is not applied.

per_page.description: Pagination page size. Maximum value is 60.

sort.description: Sort option. Allowed values: newest | name_asc | name_desc | price_asc | price_desc | popular | most_sale.

price_min.description: Minimum price filter. Applies pv.price >= price_min.

price_max.description: Maximum price filter. Applies pv.price <= price_max.

filters.description: Facet filters. Format: filters[filter_id][]=value_id. Different filters are combined with AND logic, while values inside the same filter are combined with OR logic. If main_category_id is not provided, meta.filters may be returned as an empty array because category sidebar filters are built only for a category tree.

endpoints.description: Returns product detail by variation slug. The slug path parameter must match product_variation_translations.slug. Business rule: product detail works through product variations, and every product must have at least one variation. The response returns current_price for active_variation and also returns payment_methods calculated against the active variation's real current price. If an active discount hour exists and the variation or its product is included in the campaign, discount_price is used as current_price. If payment_methods include installments, base_total, interest_amount, total_with_interest, and monthly_amount are calculated from the active variation current_price.

Creates an order directly from the variation selected on the product detail page. The endpoint creates a temporary cart in the background, adds the selected variation to it, validates stock, creates the order, and returns the flow according to the selected payment method. Authenticated customers may send address_id. If an authenticated customer does not send address_id and does not send an address payload, the system automatically selects the default address. If the authenticated customer has no address, a validation error is returned. Guest users must send address data inside the address object. name, surname, and passport_fin are not part of the address object; they are sent as root fields and stored in the order address snapshot. Offline payment methods return a successful order response immediately. Online payment methods return the order together with a payment object and redirect_url. The existing customer or guest cart is not modified. The order in the response is returned in the extended OrderResource format, including customer, guest_token, totals.initial_payment, totals.remaining_installment_total, totals.monthly_amount, totals.payable_total, address.name, address.surname, address.passport_fin, items.image, payments, and status_histories.
endpoints.authorization: Public. Authorization: Bearer {token} may be sent for authenticated customers.

qty.description: Product quantity. Defaults to 1 when omitted. The requested quantity cannot be greater than the variation stock.

name.description: Additional personal information for the order. It is sent as a root field, not inside the address object.

surname.description: Additional personal information for the order. It is sent as a root field, not inside the address object.

passport_fin.description: Additional personal information for the order. It is sent as a root field, not inside the address object.

address_id.description: Used only for authenticated customers. If address_id is provided, address payload must not be sent. If an authenticated customer does not provide address_id and does not provide address, the system automatically selects the default address.

address.description: Must be sent as a nested object for guest users or for authenticated customers who do not use address_id. name, surname, and passport_fin are not part of this object.

delivery_price_id.description: Required when address_id is not provided. It must be an active delivery price ID.

payment_method.description: Active payment method key from the order_payment_methods table.

payment_installment_id.description: Required when the selected payment method supports installments.

endpoints.description: Returns all active product category menus where menus.type=categories. The response is optimized for the catalog menu UI and contains only the required fields. Language is resolved from the request header by the application locale middleware.
Returns the currently active discount hour if one exists. A discount hour is active when status=Active and starts_at <= now <= ends_at. If no active discount hour exists, data is returned as null.

Returns the active product filter whose translated name or slug matches brand-related keywords such as brand, brands, brend, brendi, brendler, brendlər, бренд, бренды, or бренди. The response uses the same product filter structure used in product list and product detail APIs. Brand values are returned from active product_filter_values of the resolved brand filter.
